adapter_protocol.comments: lines whose first non-whitespace character is % are ignored outside quoted fields
adapter_protocol.attributes: parse ordered @attribute declarations; preserve every non-target attribute in original order
adapter_protocol.target: use the exact committed default_target_attribute and require exactly one matching attribute
adapter_protocol.data: parse comma-separated dense rows with CSV quoting; sparse rows are rejected
adapter_protocol.missing: preserve ? as an explicit feature token
adapter_protocol.labels: target tokens must be nonempty; label values are not used by record sampling or state selection
adapter_protocol.shape: every row must contain exactly the declared attribute count and match committed instance/feature counts

It is not outside-human reproduction, direct state-of-the-art superiority, peer review, publication acceptance, a general-AI breakthrough, or a world-level/world-first claim. Every failed threshold remains a preserved rejection.
